summary: This note is a Wikipedia-derived list of Ghost Whisperer characters, here covering two entries: Jim Clancy, Melinda's husband, and Beth Gordon, Melinda's mother. It describes Jim's role as the only cast member besides Jennifer Love Hewitt in every episode. It also details Beth's ability to communicate with ghosts, her refusal to use it, her past relationship with Paul Eastman, and how the truth about her biological father came out in the episode "Pater Familias".
one_line: Character list entries for Ghost Whisperer, covering Jim Clancy and Beth Gordon and their roles in the series.
key_facts: Jim Clancy is played by David Conrad and is Melinda's husband.
Jim Clancy is the only cast member other than Jennifer Love Hewitt to appear in every episode.
Beth Gordon is portrayed by Anne Archer and is Melinda's mother and Aiden's grandmother.
Beth Gordon has the ability to communicate with ghosts but chooses not to.
Beth Gordon never came to terms with her mother or Melinda regarding their gifts.
Beth Gordon prefers not to speak of anything related to ghosts or her husband Tom Gordon.
Before meeting Tom, Beth Gordon was in a relationship with Paul Eastman, with whom she was having a baby when he went to jail.
After Paul Eastman died, Beth Gordon married Tom Gordon and never told Melinda about her real father.
In the episode "Pater Familias", Paul convinces Beth to tell Melinda the truth.
In "Pater Familias", Beth is invited to watch the tall ships come into the harbor with Melinda, Jim, Rick, Delia, and Ned.
Beth Gordon appeared in the episodes "Melinda's First Ghost", "The Vanishing", "The Underneath", and "Pater Familias".
